arguments.query: SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts), count(distinct channel) FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id)) pay, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id AND payment_status="paid")) paid, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id)) ship, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL)) deliv, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)) ref FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status
SELECT payment_status, count(*) FROM payments GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(*), count(DISTINCT o.order_id), sum(p.payment_status="ok") ok, sum(p.payment_status="failed") f FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status

SELECT o.status, count(DISTINCT o.order_id), count(DISTINCT s.order_id) ship, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL THEN s.order_id END) deliv FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status

SELECT count(*), sum(n), round(1.0*sum(n)/count(*),4) FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*) n FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts>="2025-01-01" AND order_ts<"2026-01-01" GROUP BY customer_id HAVING n>=2)
